flags.effect: Take the other machine's copy of a conflict row instead of keeping yours (repeatable)
flags.name: --take

flags.effect: Apply the plan; without it the command only plans and writes nothing
flags.name: --apply

flags.effect: The plan hash printed by the dry run; apply refuses when this machine or the remote changed since
flags.name: --plan

flags.name: --unattended

summary: Plan the file on the transport against this machine (dry run); apply it with the plan hash. Rows both machines changed keep this machine's until taken; nothing is merged (--take, --apply, --plan, --unattended)
